Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (8 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.021), which favours a robust combination.
